title: CoWorld-VLA: Thinking in a Multi-Expert World Model for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2605.10426v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing reasoning mechanisms still struggle to provide planning-oriented intermediate representations: textual Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fails to preserve continuous spatiotemporal structure, while latent world reasoning remains difficult to use as a direct condition for action generation. In this paper, we propose CoWorld-VLA, a multi-expert world reasoning framework for autonomous driving, where world representations serve as explicit conditions to guide action planning. CoWorld-VLA extracts complementary world information through multi-source supervision and encodes it into expert tokens within the VLA, thereby providing planner-accessible conditioning signals. translated_title: CoWorld-VLA：在多专家世界模型中思考以实现自动驾驶
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为端到端自动驾驶的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有的推理机制仍难以提供面向规划的中间表示：文本链式思维（CoT）无法保留连续的时空结构，而潜在世界推理也难以直接作为动作生成的条件。在本文中，我们提出了CoWorld-VLA，一种用于自动驾驶的多专家世界推理框架，其中世界表示作为显式条件来指导动作规划。CoWorld-VLA通过多源监督提取互补的世界信息，并将其编码为VLA中的专家令牌，从而提供规划器可访问的条件信号。具体来说，我们构建了四种类型的令牌：语义交互、几何结构、动态演化和自我轨迹令牌，它们分别...
tldr: CoWorld-VLA通过多专家世界模型将互补的世界信息编码为显式条件令牌，从而为自动驾驶动作规划提供可访问的指导信号。
en_tdlr: CoWorld-VLA encodes complementary world information into explicit expert tokens via a multi-expert world model, providing accessible conditioning signals for autonomous driving action planning.
